channel.title: Puraniks Abitante Fiore Bavdhan Pune | Official Updates & News
channel.description: Latest project updates, MahaRERA milestone certifications, pricing releases, and construction progress for Puraniks Abitante Fiore, Bavdhan Budruk, Pune.

item.title: Puraniks Abitante Phase 2A Receives Occupancy Certificate (OC)
item.description: Phase 2A (MahaRERA: P52100020202) achieves ready possession milestone with completed OC, vitrified flooring, and functional Club Azzurro amenities in Bavdhan Budruk, Pune.

item.title: Official 2026 Cost Sheet & Price List Released for Abitante Fiore
item.description: Transparent all-inclusive pricing schedule released: 1 BHK from ₹59 Lakhs*, 2 BHK from ₹72.99 Lakhs*, and 3 BHK from ₹1.10 Crore* with Zero Stamp Duty limited festival privilege.

item.title: Chandani Chowk Flyover Reduces Bavdhan to Kothrud Commute to 5 Minutes
item.description: The fully operational multi-level Chandani Chowk infrastructure drastically cuts transit times from Puraniks Abitante to Kothrud (5 mins), Baner (12 mins), and Hinjewadi (15 mins).

item.title: Club Azzurro & Venetian Lagoon Amenities Showcase Unveiled
item.description: Experience Italian Riviera living featuring Club Azzurro, infinity swimming pool, private Juliet balcony gardens, botanical amphitheatre, and 1,000+ oxygen-generating trees.

item.title: NRI Real Estate Investment Desk Launched for Gulf & US Homebuyers
item.description: Dedicated NRI investment desk offering virtual 3D walkthroughs, dual currency documentation, power of attorney (PoA) guidance, and expected 4.8% rental yields.
